Coastal Seaclusion

11 Bedrooms 10 Full Bathrooms 1 Half Bathrooms 35 Sleeps Destin

  • Amenities
  • Video

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- Private Heated Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day from October 1 - May 1)
- Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
- Gulf Views
- Short Walk to The Beach
- Game Room
- Elevator
- Whole House Water Filtration System
- 6 Adult Bikes
- 6 Passenger Golf Cart

DESCRIPTION:
Elevating the quintessence of beach luxury living, Coastal Seaclusion stands as an opulent retreat in the heart of Destin. With 11 bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, and the ability to comfortably accommodate 35 guests, this modern masterpiece redefines lavish coastal living. Nestled in the pristine landscape of Destin, it offers panoramic Gulf views and is just a short walk to the beach, ensuring a seamless blend of tranquility and convenience.

The highlight of this residence is its outdoor oasis, featuring a private heated pool and spa. Moments of relaxation are elevated by amenities such as swim-up dining, a hot tub cascading into the pool, a cozy fire feature for intimate gatherings, and a spacious in-pool lounging deck. Culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the gourmet outdoor kitchen, complete with an oversized gas grill, ample prep space, and poolside dining tables. Inside, the chef’s dream kitchen boasts an expansive island, additional sink, banquette breakfast area, and high-end appliances, all seamlessly integrated into the elegant design.

The open-concept living spaces on the second level are bathed in natural light, accentuated by floor-to-ceiling windows and a cozy fireplace. A tongue-and-groove ceiling creates an airy atmosphere, while sliders open to the porch, offering captivating views and a perfect spot for leisurely meals. For entertainment, the home features a well-appointed game room, perfect for both kids and adults. This vibrant space is equipped with a wet bar, pool table, ping pong table, and an array of classic arcade games. The game room opens up to the outdoor oasis, seamlessly connecting indoor fun with the relaxing, resort-style backyard. The elevator provides easy access across all three levels, ensuring convenience and comfort for all guests.

For an unparalleled view of the Gulf, the home's observation deck offers an idyllic spot to unwind while soaking in the majestic Gulf sunsets. Featuring a table for six, this peaceful retreat provides the perfect setting for evening dinners or a glass of wine as you watch the sun dip below the horizon, casting a breathtaking display of colors over the water.

The 11 bedrooms present luxurious sanctuaries, with master suites featuring private baths equipped with spa showers and soaker tubs, offering a retreat for unwinding after a day in the sun. Versatile sleeping arrangements, including bunk rooms and multiple king suites, make the residence suitable for families and groups of all sizes. Additional amenities like complimentary beach setups, adult bikes, and a six-passenger golf cart add a touch of convenience and adventure, ensuring exploration of the nearby attractions and beach with ease. The property includes on-site parking for up to 10 vehicles.

Coastal Seaclusion epitomizes a modern beach home designed for luxury living, offering an unrivaled combination of comfort, style, and entertainment. With captivating Gulf views, resort-style amenities, sophisticated interior design, and an entertainment haven with a game room that opens to the outdoor oasis, this property invites guests to indulge in the finest aspects of beachfront living. The observation deck completes the experience, providing a serene space for guests to bask in the beauty of sunset views over the Gulf.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:

Bunk Room – Four twin over twin bunks

1 King – Private Bath Shower Only

Game Room – Pool Table, Ping pong table, and Golden Tee 
Common Bathroom with Shower Only
2nd Floor
Kitchen
Dining Room
1 King - Private Bath with Shower
1 King - Private Bath with Shower
1 King - Private Bath with Shower 
3rd Floor
1 King Master Suite - Private Bath with Shower and Tub Separate
1 King Master Suite– Private Bath with Shower and Tub Separate
1 King – Private Bath, Shower only
Bunk Room – One Queen Over Queen Bunk and One Twin over Twin Bunk with Shared Bath

CONVENIENT LOCATION:
Henderson Beach State Park (Approx. 2 miles east)
A state-owned park featuring over a mile of sugar-white sands, ideal for picnicking, swimming, and nature walks.

The Village of Baytowne Wharf (Approx. 7 miles east)
A vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment district offering a variety of boutiques, restaurants, and live entertainment.

Harbor Boardwalk (Approx. 1.5 miles west)
A bustling waterfront area with shops, restaurants, and opportunities for dolphin watching and fishing.

Destin Commons (Approx. 3 miles northeast)
An open-air shopping center offering a variety of stores, restaurants, and entertainment, including a movie theater and a children’s play area.

The Track (Approx. 2 miles west)
A family-friendly amusement park featuring go-karts, mini-golf, bumper boats, and an arcade, perfect for kids and adults alike.

Silver Sands Premium Outlets (Approx. 7 miles east)
A luxury outlet mall with a wide range of designer brands at discounted prices, offering shopping for every taste and budget.

-Home was previously named 'Lost Shaker of Salt'

**During peak season, all of our properties are rented with a 7-night minimum from Saturday to Saturday.**

Fourth Year At Coastal Seaclusion

by Randal Robert
Our family of 28 returned to Coastal Seaclusion for the fourth consecutive year for our annual family vacation. Once again the house was perfect for all ranging from our patriarch (98 yo) to the latest great grandchild (2 yo). The highlights include: 1) a fully equipped chefs kitchen, 2) dining that afforded seating for all of us, 3) large open living spaces, 4) a great game room for the kids (and some big kids), 5) a resort like pool and spa, and 6) large bedrooms with en-suite baths. The 6 person golf cart made the one block trip to the beach quite convenient. The staff, as always, was helpful and responsive to all of our needs. We have already booked year five for 2026!
